entities.name: Additional update result
entities.description: IE included by the network to provide UE with additional information about the result of tracking area updating procedures.

entities.name: Combined tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure for updating tracking area for both EPS and non-EPS services or EPS services and SMS only.

entities.name: Normal tracking area updating procedure for CIoT EPS optimizations
entities.description: Procedure for updating tracking area requested for CIoT EPS optimizations.

entities.name: Procedure successful for EPS and non-EPS services
entities.description: Condition where combined tracking area updating procedure succeeds for both EPS and non-EPS services.

entities.name: Procedure successful for EPS services and SMS only
entities.description: Condition where tracking area updating procedure succeeds for EPS services and SMS only.

relations.description: IE is included when combined tracking area updating procedure is successful for EPS and non-EPS services or EPS and SMS only.
IE is included when normal tracking area updating procedure for CIoT EPS optimizations is successful for EPS services and SMS only.
Combined tracking area updating procedure requires success for EPS and non-EPS services for IE inclusion.
Combined tracking area updating procedure requires success for EPS services and SMS only for IE inclusion.
Normal tracking area updating procedure for CIoT EPS optimizations requires success for EPS services and SMS only for IE inclusion.
